newsitem.title: USA: Network Long Distance hires merger adviser.
newsitem.headline: Network Long Distance hires merger adviser.

text.p: Network Long Distance Inc said Tuesday it had engaged an investment banking firm with experience in the purchase and sale of telecommunications companies to explore various options for maximizing shareholder value.
It said Seruus Ventures LLC had been retained to target and review all opportunities for enhancing NLD's public and private market valuation.
Included in this process, the company said, is the implementation of a plan to further expand the scope and accelerate the pace of its mergers and acquisitions program.

"With more than 950 independent long distance companies currently operating across the U.S., it is obvious that this is an industry ripe for consolidation," said Michael Ross, NLD chief executive officer.
Prior to hiring Seruus, NLD made more than a dozen acquisitions, the company said.
NLD is a switch-based inter-exchange carrier providing service to commercial customers, independent agents and other long-distance firms.
